mapper.select: SELECT F.flight_id, F.flight_no, F.route_id, F.aircraft_id, F.departure_gate_id, F.arrival_gate_id, TO_CHAR(F.departure_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS departure_time, TO_CHAR(F.arrival_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS arrival_time, F.flight_status, F.delay_minutes, F.is_deleted, AD.iata_code || ' → ' || AA.iata_code AS route_name, AC.reg_no || ' (' || AC.model_name || ')' AS aircraft_name, GD.gate_code AS dep_gate_code, GA.gate_code AS arr_gate_code FROM FLIGHT F JOIN ROUTE R ON F.route_id = R.route_id JOIN AIRPORT AD ON R.departure_airport_id = AD.airport_id JOIN AIRPORT AA ON R.arrival_airport_id = AA.airport_id JOIN AIRCRAFT AC ON F.aircraft_id = AC.aircraft_id LEFT JOIN GATE GD ON F.departure_gate_id = GD.gate_id LEFT JOIN GATE GA ON F.arrival_gate_id = GA.gate_id WHERE F.is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY F.departure_time DESC

SELECT F.flight_id, F.flight_no, F.route_id, F.aircraft_id, F.departure_gate_id, F.arrival_gate_id, TO_CHAR(F.departure_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS departure_time, TO_CHAR(F.arrival_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS arrival_time, F.flight_status, F.delay_minutes, F.is_deleted FROM FLIGHT F WHERE F.flight_id = #{flight_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FLIGHT ( flight_no, route_id, aircraft_id, departure_gate_id, arrival_gate_id, departure_time, arrival_time, flight_status, delay_minutes, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{flight_no}, #{route_id}, #{aircraft_id}, #{departure_gate_id}, #{arrival_gate_id}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{departure_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{arrival_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'SCHEDULED', 0, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE FLIGHT SET route_id = #{route_id}, aircraft_id = #{aircraft_id}, departure_gate_id = #{departure_gate_id}, arrival_gate_id = #{arrival_gate_id}, departure_time = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{departure_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), arrival_time = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{arrival_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE flight_id = #{flight_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FLIGHT_FARE ( flight_id, seat_class_id, fare_id, price ) SELECT f.flight_id, fa.seat_class_id, fa.fare_id, fa.price FROM FLIGHT f JOIN FARE fa ON fa.route_id = f.route_id AND fa.is_active = 'Y' JOIN SEASON se ON se.season_id = fa.season_id AND se.is_active = 'Y' AND CAST(f.departure_time AS DATE) >= TRUNC(se.start_date) AND CAST(f.departure_time AS DATE) < TRUNC(se.end_date) + 1 WHERE f.flight_id = #{flight_id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEASON WHERE is_active = 'Y' AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{departure_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') >= TRUNC(start_date) AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{departure_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') < TRUNC(end_date) + 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FARE fa JOIN SEASON se ON se.season_id = fa.season_id AND se.is_active = 'Y' WHERE fa.route_id = #{route_id} AND fa.is_active = 'Y' AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{departure_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') >= TRUNC(se.start_date) AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{departure_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') < TRUNC(se.end_date) + 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TICKET WHERE flight_id = #{flight_id} AND hold_status IN ('HOLDING', 'CONFIRMED')

SELECT R.route_id, R.flight_type,
DEP.airport_id AS departure_airport_id, ARR.airport_id AS arrival_airport_id,
TRIM(DEP.iata_code) AS departure_airport_code, TRIM(ARR.iata_code) AS arrival_airport_code
FROM ROUTE R
JOIN AIRPORT DEP ON DEP.airport_id = R.departure_airport_id
JOIN AIRPORT ARR ON ARR.airport_id = R.arrival_airport_id
WHERE R.route_id = #{route_id} AND R.is_active = 'Y'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM FLIGHT F
WHERE F.aircraft_id = #{aircraft_id} AND F.is_deleted = 'N' AND F.flight_status != 'CANCELLED'
AND F.flight_id != #{exclude_flight_id}
AND F.departure_time < TO_TIMESTAMP( REPLACE(#{arrival_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' )
AND F.arrival_time > TO_TIMESTAMP( REPLACE(#{departure_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' )

SELECT *
FROM ( SELECT F.flight_id, F.flight_no, F.route_id, F.aircraft_id,
TO_CHAR( F.departure_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI' ) AS departure_time,
TO_CHAR( F.arrival_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI' ) AS arrival_time,
R.flight_type,
DEP.airport_id AS departure_airport_id, ARR.airport_id AS arrival_airport_id,
TRIM(DEP.iata_code) AS departure_airport_code, TRIM(ARR.iata_code) AS arrival_airport_code
FROM FLIGHT F
JOIN ROUTE R ON R.route_id = F.route_id
JOIN AIRPORT DEP ON DEP.airport_id = R.departure_airport_id
JOIN AIRPORT ARR ON ARR.airport_id = R.arrival_airport_id
WHERE F.aircraft_id = #{aircraft_id} AND F.is_deleted = 'N' AND F.flight_status != 'CANCELLED'
AND F.flight_id != #{exclude_flight_id}
AND F.arrival_time <= TO_TIMESTAMP( REPLACE(#{departure_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' )
ORDER BY F.arrival_time DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT *
FROM ( SELECT F.flight_id, F.flight_no, F.route_id, F.aircraft_id,
TO_CHAR( F.departure_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI' ) AS departure_time,
TO_CHAR( F.arrival_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI' ) AS arrival_time,
R.flight_type,
DEP.airport_id AS departure_airport_id, ARR.airport_id AS arrival_airport_id,
TRIM(DEP.iata_code) AS departure_airport_code, TRIM(ARR.iata_code) AS arrival_airport_code
FROM FLIGHT F
JOIN ROUTE R ON R.route_id = F.route_id
JOIN AIRPORT DEP ON DEP.airport_id = R.departure_airport_id
JOIN AIRPORT ARR ON ARR.airport_id = R.arrival_airport_id
WHERE F.aircraft_id = #{aircraft_id} AND F.is_deleted = 'N' AND F.flight_status != 'CANCELLED'
AND F.flight_id != #{exclude_flight_id}
AND F.departure_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP( REPLACE(#{arrival_time}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' )
ORDER BY F.departure_time ASC )
WHERE ROWNUM = 1
